name: Ahmet Coşkun
bio:
Dr. Ahmet Coşkun, DDS: Big Brother of Play, pediatric dentist, dreamer, game creator, storyteller and author.

Believing that the magical way to connect with children is through play, Dr. Coşkun helps them feel comfortable enough to sit in the dentist’s chair on their own. Sometimes he talks through the characters from their favorite books, and other times he opens the door to their imaginations with a simple game of peekaboo. But every time, he sends them off with smiles on their faces. He continues to help his little friends as a dentist in Istanbul.
